sources.title: LLaMA 3.1 8B Model Overview - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: The LLaMA 3.1 8B model is an open, dense, decoder-only Transformer-based LLM featuring approximately 8 billion parameters. As part of the LLaMA 3 "herd" of models, it is designed for general-purpose natural language understanding and generation, with strong support for multilinguality, reasoning, coding, tool usage, and extensibility to multimodal domains via adapters. sources.title: Llama (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Llama[a] (" Large Language Model Meta AI " serving as a backronym) was a family of large language models (LLMs) released by Meta AI from February 2023 to April 2025. [3] Llama models come in different sizes, ranging from 1 billion to 2 trillion parameters.
